generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The intending bidder / tenderer should furnish the copy of the certificate of registration issued by state/central govt.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Intending bidders / tenderer are advised to visit the site of work and also access the tender documents well in advance.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The TENDER PROCEESING FEE will not be refunded.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement Portal Portal.

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the bidders in a complete manner. Incomplete formats may constitute sufficient reason at the discretion of CNNL for rejection of the bid.

The requisite Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Through ONLINE only With validity from the date of opening of the tender. The tender schedule will be issued to the applicants who make payment through ONLINE only. Tenders received without valid EMD through e- payment will be rejected. Under this section of qualifying criteria the tenderer should furnish capacity details / format.

All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer will verify the original documents at any stage before recommending for approval. Bidders should produce their original documents for verification during office hours related to uploaded documents in e-portal immediately after opening of technical Bid.

Further particulars, if any, required by the bidders can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, No 7 HLBC Division Nagamangala during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the calendar of any event mentioned above happen to be General Holiday / Declared holiday, the next working day will hold good for the respective events.

The intending bidders should note that, if any of the lands (either in part/parts or in whole) required for the work is not yet acquired by the Nigama, it shall be the responsibility of the successful bidder to take possession of such land by consent of the owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Nigama and no claims whatsoever relating to non-availability of land would be entertained.
Defect liability period will be Three years from the date of completion of the entire work, after issuing of work completion certificate from CNNL.
Tenderers shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka.
The Tenderer should furnish the Name of the individual / firm/ Company with address and telephone number with place of registration, year of incorporation etc.,

The application made by the firm / company shall be signed by a person holding the power of attorney, in which case the Tenderer should furnish a copy of power of attorney signed by the board of directors in e-portal along with their bid.
The scanned signature of the bidders / authorized representatives of the bidders shall be attached while uploading the Bid document.

Necessary certificates should be signed by an officer not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or equivalent competent authority and should be countersigned by the superior officer not below the rank of Superintending Engineer or equivalent competent authority.

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide accurate information on the related form about any litigation or Arbitration resulting from contracts completed or ongoing under its execution over the last five years. The consisting history of awards against the tenderer may result in failure of the application.
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return for the preceding five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26)

The intending Bidder/firm/company shall provide the audited balance sheets or other financial statements acceptable to the employer for the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and must demonstrate the current soundness of the applicant financial position and indicate its prospective long term profitability. If deemed necessary the employer shall have the authority to make enquiries with the applicants bankers.
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate along with updated GST clearance copies.

Royalty Recovery from the contractors bill will be made as per Government Circular CI 81/MMN 2014 Bangalore Dt: 05-03-2014 & Circular from the office of Director Mines & Geology Department Dt: 13-03-2014 & Circular from the office of Director Mines & Geology Department Dt: 06.09.2018 & Circular from the office of Director Mines & Geology Department Dt: 12.12.2019 further any Orders/Circulars issued by Government of Karnataka from time to time.

The rates quoted by the contractor must be excluding GST The contractor is also required to pay quarry Fees, Royalties, Octroi Dues levied by the state Government or any Local body or an authority and ground rent, if any, charged by the Executive Engineer for stacking materials. No Extra Payment on this account will be made to the contractor.
Applicable GST will be paid separately and GST will be deducted as per the prevailing Govt orders from time to time.
Increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the Contractor themselves and should get the same tested by the quality control authority of CNNL before use in this work.

The work includes all lead and lift / de lift and work shall be carried out as per instruction of engineer-in-charge of the work. And all the specification as per Indian road congress and all relevant Indian codes. The rate for the specifications in the Schedule-B includes all lead and lift, irrespective of distance and height. No extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts.

If CNNL Shall engage third party consultants / PMC for quality control assessment as per G.O No.FD 55 Pro.Cell 2004, Bangalore dated17,02,2002, apart from the CNNL quality control and field tests, the contractor should co-operate with both Quality control authorities and the third party.

Performance security:-Within 20 days of receipt of the letter of acceptance, successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer a security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5.00% of the contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders (If quoted below) in accordance with the clause 25. 5 of ITT and clause 43 of the conditions of the contract. Cash/ Bankers cheque/ Demand draft/ Pay order in favor of Executive Engineer, No.7 HLBC Division, Nagamangala payable at Nagamangala or specified small saving instruments pledged to Executive Engineer, No.7 HLBC Division, Nagamangala.
Security Deposit Will be withheld till the expiry of the defect liability period.

Building and other construction workers welfare cess The contractor shall subscribe 1.00% of gross amount of each bill payable to him in respect of contract to the building and other construction workers welfare cess as per GO No: LD 300 LET 2006, Bangalore, dated: 18-01-2007. The amount of subscription will be recovered out of payable amount to him in each bill. This component is deemed to have been included in the quoted rate / Item rate.
Sub leasing /sub contracting in any form is prohibited. Bids of bidders with track record of Sub leasing / subcontracting are liable for rejection

The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, ascertain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard.

On account of restrictions on sand mining and scarcity of availability of sand, as an alternative the use of manufactured sand (M-sand) confirming to relevant IS specifications may be allowed during the remodeling work

Successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of acceptance, failing which his tender will be cancelled on Risk & Cost basis and his EMD will be forfeited.

The contractor should obtain the material dispatch permit for stone, aggregates, sand and murrum etc., will be used in the construction work from the mines and geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the work bill, then for such work bills no royalty will be deducted. if the contractor failed to submit the material dispatch permit (MDP) along with the work bill five times royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and circular vide no.Ga,Bhu.E/DCB/DCB/takte/2019-20/4497 dated:12.12.19 by mines and geology department.
Related to technical qualification condition, Idle charges for men & machineries for non- progress period delayed due to any reasons will not be paid.
As per FD GO dated 26.03.2019, NSIC exemption for EMD is not accepted.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.

All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/private Properties and to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting.
Contractor should fallow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.
CNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasons.
Typo graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor.
The undersigned reserves the right to either postpone or to cancel the entire process of tender.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
The bidder should upload valid ESI and EPF registration certificate.

The tenders are invited as per standard tender Bid document KW-3, The tenderer should go through all the tender condition All the original documents uploaded in e-portal should be submitted for verification to the Executive Engineer, No 7 HLBC Division, Nagamangala office within 2 days from last date of submission of tender, otherwise the tender is liable for rejection

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder/firm/Company should have Satisfactorily completed (at Least 90% of the contract value as prime contractor), at least one similar nature of work such as Tank improvements of value not less than Rs.41.02 Lakhs (Usually not less than 50% of Estimated Value of contract) during any one year of the last five financial years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 An additional weightage of 10% each year will be added to the cost of the work done to bring it to the 2026-27 price level.

Each bidder/firm/company should have executed in any one year of the last five years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 the following minimum quantities of work 1. Cement concrete of all grades-473.00 Cum 2. Steel-5.38 tonne 3.EWE/De-Silting-12599.00cum

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity:-(AxNx2.5-B) where, A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N- Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B-Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next three months(period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).
The intending bidder should furnish the KPWD Class III & above Contractor certificate of registration issued by State/Central govt. organization.
